name: meeting-scribe
author: Francisco Stanley Rodrigues Albuquerque
description: Self-hosted real-time meeting transcription (Teams/Meet) — NestJS, Next.js, Electron, Whisper

scripts.dev: node scripts/bootstrap.mjs --skip-docker && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @meeting-scribe/backend" "npm run dev -w @meeting-scribe/frontend"
scripts.dev:with-docker-stt: node scripts/bootstrap.mjs && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @meeting-scribe/backend" "npm run dev -w @meeting-scribe/frontend"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run bootstrap && npm run dev -w @meeting-scribe/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @meeting-scribe/shared && npm run build -w @meeting-scribe/backend && npm run build -w @meeting-scribe/frontend && npm run build -w @meeting-scribe/desktop
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @meeting-scribe/shared && npm run build -w @meeting-scribe/backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w @meeting-scribe/shared && npm run build -w @meeting-scribe/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @meeting-scribe/backend && npm run lint -w @meeting-scribe/frontend && npm run lint -w @meeting-scribe/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @meeting-scribe/shared && npm run test -w @meeting-scribe/backend && npm run test -w @meeting-scribe/frontend
